title: AIAS Level 5 Organizational Assurance System
purpose: Separate demonstrated reference capability from independently audited longitudinal organizational maturity.
scope: Systems, six criteria, evidence classifications, metrics, observation windows, project counts, critical findings, independent audit and explicit gaps.

requirements.title: Evidence classification
requirements.statement: Assurance evidence shall distinguish reference validation, production observation and independent audit.
requirements.rationale: Prevent test evidence from masquerading as production maturity.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reference capability
requirements.statement: Reference Level 5 shall require all designated systems and criterion validation evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Longitudinal maturity
requirements.statement: Organizational Level 5 shall require at least 365 days, ten projects, production evidence and threshold metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Independent audit
requirements.statement: Organizational Level 5 shall require a conformant independent attestation with no critical findings.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Immediate consumer
requirements.statement: Current AIAS evidence shall assess as reference Level 5 while organizational audited level remains null.
requirements.rationale: Publish an honest current maturity state.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: Level 5 assurance shall include tests, documentation, installer, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
